definitions.explanation: A question or statement designed to be solved or guessed; a word game or brain teaser.
Something that is difficult to understand or explain; an unsolved question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{謎|なぞ}{解|と}き→なぞ解き：25873_nazotoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦{謎|なぞ}{解|と}き→なぞ解き：25873_nazotoki⟧ = solving riddles/puzzles
{謎|なぞ}を⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ = to solve a riddle/mystery

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{謎|なぞ}{掛|か}け→謎かけ：25797_nazokake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かります→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can you figure out the answer to this riddle?
examples.notes: ⟦{謎|なぞ}{掛|か}け→謎かけ：25797_nazokake⟧ = wordplay riddle

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{謎|なぞ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し{合|あ}って→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I played with my friends, taking turns asking each other riddles.

examples.japanese: {謎|なぞ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。

examples.english: There are many mysteries in the universe.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{謎|なぞ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれている→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: This case is shrouded in mystery.
examples.notes: {謎|なぞ}に⟦{包|つつ}まれている→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ = shrouded in mystery

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{謎|なぞ}⟦だらけ→～だらけ：18372_darake⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His behavior is full of mysteries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}しても→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{謎|なぞ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解|と}けない→解く：02301_toku⟧⟦まま→〜まま：02007_mama⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Even after years of research, this mystery remains unsolved.

notes:
USAGE: {謎|なぞ} refers to both playful riddles and serious mysteries. Context determines which meaning applies.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {謎|なぞ}を⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (to solve a mystery/riddle)
- {謎|なぞ}が⟦{解|と}ける→解く：02301_toku⟧ (a mystery is solved)
- {謎|なぞ}に⟦{包|つつ}まれる→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to be shrouded in mystery)
- {謎|なぞ}が⟦{深|ふか}まる→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧ (the mystery deepens)
- ⟦{謎|なぞ}{解|と}き→なぞ解き：25873_nazotoki⟧ (solving riddles; mystery-solving)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{謎|なぞ}{掛|か}け→謎かけ：25797_nazokake⟧ (riddle, wordplay)
- {謎|なぞ}の⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧ (mysterious person)
- {謎|なぞ}めいた (mysterious, enigmatic)

CULTURAL NOTE: ⟦{謎|なぞ}{掛|か}け→謎かけ：25797_nazokake⟧ is a traditional Japanese form of wordplay where the answer connects two seemingly unrelated things through a pun.
